'''Malussa the Gleaming Star''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] living during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malussa the Gleaming Star was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion as a World Boss for Dark vs. Light system. Whenever [[Light side of the Force]] reaches victory state on a server, Malussa the Gleaming Star has a chance to spawn at one or more of selected locations on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] alongside other Light Side World Bosses. Though killing her is required for an in-game achievement, it is impossible to know the year and the planet where her death took place.
